description: Unit test for DefaultDittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter class, testing logging behaviors and MDC management for a diagnostic logging adapter in an Akka-based system.

classes.name: DefaultDittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapterTest
classes.description: Test class for DefaultDittoDiagnosticLoggingAdapter, verifying correct handling of MDC entries and logging levels.

methods.name: getInstanceWithNullLogger
methods.description: Tests that providing null as a logger results in NullPointerException.

methods.name: getInstanceWithNullLoggerName
methods.description: Tests that providing null as a logger name results in NullPointerException.

methods.name: getInstanceWithBlankLoggerName
methods.description: Tests that providing an empty string as logger name results in IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: getNameReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that getName() returns the correct logger name.

methods.name: withCorrelationIdLogInfo
methods.description: Verifies setting a correlation ID and logging info messages with MDC entries.

methods.name: withMdcEntryLogDebug
methods.description: Checks that MDC entries are set correctly during debug logs.

methods.name: withTwoMdcEntryPairsLogDebug
methods.description: Checks multiple MDC pairs are handled correctly during debug logging.

methods.name: withThreeMdcEntryPairsLogDebug
methods.description: Checks handling of three MDC entries during debug logging.

methods.name: withTwoMdcEntriesLogWarning
methods.description: Verifies multiple MDC entries during warning logs.

methods.name: putNothingToMdcAndDoNotLogAsInfoIsDisabled
methods.description: Ensures no logs are emitted if info level is disabled.

methods.name: logDebugAndWarnWithTwoMdcValuesThenDiscardMdcEntries
methods.description: Verifies MDC entries are discarded after logging debug and warning.

methods.name: removeMdcEntryViaKey
methods.description: Removes a specific MDC entry by key and verifies MDC update.

methods.name: removeMdcEntryViaNullValue
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry when its value is null.

methods.name: setCorrelationIdLogErrorDoNotDiscard
methods.description: Checks that setting correlation ID logs error without discarding MDC.

methods.name: setCorrelationIdLogErrorDoNotClose
methods.description: Verifies error logs with correlation ID do not close MDC.

methods.name: setCorrelationIdLogInfoThenDiscardCorrelationId
methods.description: Tests that correlation ID can be set and then discarded after info logs.

methods.name: logMoreThan4LoggingArgsError
methods.description: Verifies that error logs with more than 4 arguments are formatted correctly.

methods.name: logMoreThan4LoggingArgsWarning
methods.description: Verifies warning logs with more than 4 arguments are formatted correctly.

methods.name: logMoreThan4LoggingArgsInfo
methods.description: Verifies info logs with more than 4 arguments are formatted correctly.

methods.name: logMoreThan4LoggingArgsDebug
methods.description: Verifies debug logs with more than 4 arguments are formatted correctly.
